name: Samsara
summary: Fleet operations platform: AI dash cams, GPS telematics, ELD compliance and trailer and equipment tracking, sold as separate packages to fleets.
best_for: fleets that want safety cameras, telematics and equipment tracking from one vendor and are prepared to negotiate a multi-package quote
skip_if: you run a handful of vehicles and want a price before a sales call: Samsara publishes none, and the terms renew automatically unless you cancel in writing 30 days before the end
honest_knock: Seven named packages and not one price. The pricing page asks how many vehicles you run and leads to a sales form; the plans page ends every package in Get pricing. The contract side is public and worth reading before the call: under section 13.1 of the Platform Terms, if you do not cancel auto-renewal in writing at least 30 days before the licence ends, Samsara may renew for up to a year or the length of your previous term, whichever is greater. Put that date in your calendar on day one. Licensed hardware is covered for as long as the licence runs; accessories and cables get one year.

pricing.notes: (read 2026-10-10 on samsara.com/pricing and samsara.com/resources/plans, US site) No prices are shown. The pricing page opens a form that first asks how many vehicles or assets you have (1-5, 6-29, 30-499, 500-4,999 or 5,000+) and prints no figure. The Pricing and Plans page names seven packages: Safety Premier and Safety Enterprise, Telematics Premier and Telematics Enterprise, Standard Visibility and Advanced Tracking for trailers and equipment, and the Fleet Application Suite. Every one of them ends in a Get pricing button; none carries a per-vehicle rate, a hardware cost or a contract length.

cost_traps.label: Quote-only pricing
cost_traps.evidence: No published price: samsara.com/pricing is a fleet-size form and samsara.com/resources/plans names seven packages, each with a Get pricing button and no amount (read 10 Oct 2026)

open_questions.question: Can you publish a price, or a starting price, for the plans that are quote-only?
Can a customer cancel at any time, and what happens to an annual plan that is cancelled mid-term?
Which data can a customer export, in which formats, on which plans?
Where is customer data stored, and can a customer choose the region?
Is there a minimum number of seats or users on any plan?
